prompt.zh-TW: 初陽貿易今年營業收入 {{money:vars.revenue}}，年底應收帳款 {{money:vars.ar}}。依課程 Excel 口徑（用期末餘額）計算應收款項週轉率，以「次」作答。
prompt.en: First Light Trading had revenue of {{money:vars.revenue}} this year and trade receivables of {{money:vars.ar}} at year end. Using the course Excel basis (closing balance), what is the receivables turnover? Answer in times.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_2s4hterv}}＝{{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}} ÷ {{term:tm_r7x2c9fa}}，意思是一年之中應收帳款「賒出去、收回來」大約轉了幾輪。年報用平均餘額，課程 Excel 用期末餘額近似；分子是營收、分母是餘額，不要顛倒。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_2s4hterv}} = {{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}} ÷ {{term:tm_r7x2c9fa}}: roughly how many times in a year receivables are extended and collected. Annual reports use the average balance; the course Excel uses the closing balance as an approximation. Revenue on top, balance underneath, never the other way round.
